subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the public provider-plugin retry callback permanently expose `attempt`, `apiKeyIndex`, and `attemptNumber`, with `attempt` retained as a deprecated zero-based alias?
rationale: The helper is exported through the public provider-auth SDK, so naming, compatibility duration, and deprecation policy become maintained third-party API rather than an internal implementation detail.

options.title: Approve additive contract
options.body: Keep the compatibility alias, add the two explicit fields, document their semantics, and require SDK-surface plus real-runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Redesign before merge
options.body: Pause this PR and define a narrower callback result or replacement API if maintainers do not want three overlapping numeric fields in the permanent SDK.

options.title: Keep existing API
options.body: Close the PR and issue if exposing per-key attempt metadata is not worth expanding the provider-plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Approve additive contract
recommendation.body: Keep the compatibility alias, add the two explicit fields, document their semantics, and require SDK-surface plus real-runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior originates in their generic API-key rotation implementation, and the decision affects the public provider-plugin SDK boundary.
